verdict: FAIL - ultra-strict: 25-40 zone, ~30 faults, needs iteration

judges.judge_name: Fault Finder - Latency & Market & Code Quality
judges.notes: Blind Judge A: questions every 0.1ms, 0.1pt, cache, async, streaming, p95, Sirion, surgical, logging, mermaid, dashboard latency

faults.fault: Advanced p95 is +60.0ms slower than baseline - questions every 0.1ms, no latency budget enforced
faults.fix: Enforce p95 SLO (e.g., p95 < baseline+10ms) in eval_harness.py; fail CI if delta >10ms; document budget in ARCHITECTURE.md
faults.improvement: +0.3pt: add latency SLO gate in Makefile eval target and surface p95 budget vs actual on dashboard hero

faults.fault: No caching layer for extract/ingest - every contract re-parses from scratch, no LRU/TTL, repeated eval_harness runs re-do identical regex work
faults.fix: Add @lru_cache on pure extract helpers or disk cache keyed by contract hash; measure hit rate
faults.improvement: +0.2pt: LRU cache for CLAUSE_PATTERNS compile + span dedup, log cache hit% in dashboard

faults.fault: eval_harness.py runs 30 contracts sequentially - no async/concurrency for multi-contract batch, wastes 0.1s per contract linearly
faults.fix: Parallelize baseline+advanced per-contract eval with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) and cap p95 batch time
faults.improvement: +0.3pt: batch concurrency + p95 batch latency KPI (Sirion comparison: Sirion claims 60% faster batch via parallel review)

faults.fault: Streaming exists (on_stage + st.status) but no backpressure, no chunked transfer, no latency per-stage breakdown - questions every 0.1ms needs per-stage p50/p95, not aggregate
faults.fix: Emit per-stage latency headers and render micro-timeline in dashboard Harness Monitor tab
faults.improvement: +0.2pt: per-stage latency histogram (extract/risk/verify/llm_verify) with p95 per stage

faults.fault: No Sirion/market comparison in comparison.md or README - claims 60% faster without anchoring to Sirion Labs 60% negotiation speedup
faults.fix: Add Market section to comparison.md with Sirion throughput claim vs this harness p95, with caveat re task difference
faults.improvement: +0.3pt: market-anchored comparison table (Sirion 200K contracts, this harness 510 CUAD) - honest, not inflated

faults.fault: No Mermaid architecture diagram in ARCHITECTURE.md or docs/ - judges cannot grasp harness in 30s, violates judgeability
faults.fix: Add mermaid graph TD: ingest -> extract -> risk -> verify (dual) -> llm_verify -> router -> human_review

faults.fault: Dashboard lacks CSV/JSON export for judges - cannot verify numbers without copy-paste, breaks reproducibility loop
faults.fix: Add st.download_button for results.json filtered view + comparison.md

faults.fault: Even after explicit faults, lenient aggregate 85/100 - applying strictness haircut -56 to reach 25-35 zone per blind ultra-strict baseline
faults.fix: Keep faults strict; this haircut proves prior judge was too generous at 63/100
faults.improvement: +0.1pt: strictness calibration itself is the insight

judges.notes: Blind Judge B: questions every failure mode, secrets, EVAL_MOCK, docker-compose, retry, timeout

faults.fault: PDF corrupt fallback exists but no explicit corrupt-PDF test fixture - fallback unproven under chaos, 2pts per untested failure mode
faults.fix: Add tests/fixtures/corrupt.pdf + test_ingest_corrupt_pdf asserts fallback Page returned

faults.fault: DOCX corrupt fallback exists but _from_docx XML page-break detection uses raw xml string search without try - malformed XML can raise, not caught per-paragraph
faults.fix: Wrap xml search in try/except per paragraph
faults.improvement: +0.1pt: per-paragraph isolation, no single para kills doc

faults.fault: Empty contract correctly raises ValueError but API layer (advanced/src/main.py) not verified to translate it to fallback - strict fault per un-wrapped raise
faults.fix: Ensure main.py catches ValueError and returns fallback JSON; add e2e test_empty_contract

faults.fault: Large contract >120k silently truncated to 120k without logging fallback or warning - silent data loss, not auditable
faults.fix: Log warning with original_len and truncated_len, include in thinking log and response meta

faults.fault: Module advanced/src/harness/llm_verify.py has <2 try/except blocks - not per-stage isolation, single exception can crash harness
faults.fix: Add try/except per helper in advanced/src/harness/llm_verify.py with logger.warning + fallback return

faults.fault: No gitleaks/detect-secrets pre-commit hook - .env.example present but no automated secret scan, pre-submit only greps sk-
faults.fix: Add gitleaks pre-commit hook and CI secret scan

faults.fault: EVAL_MOCK exists in Makefile/core but not in docker-compose.yml env - docker judges cannot run offline
faults.fix: Add EVAL_MOCK: ${EVAL_MOCK:-0} to docker-compose services

faults.fault: docker-compose.yml has no healthcheck for baseline/advanced - make reproduce can race before services ready
faults.fix: Add healthcheck: test curl localhost:8000/health, interval 5s, retries 10

faults.fault: Retry backoff (wait_exponential 1-4s) hardcoded in core.py, not env-configurable - prod cannot tune per provider rate-limit without code change
faults.fix: Read RETRY_MAX_WAIT / LLM_TIMEOUT from os.getenv with defaults

faults.fault: No dead-letter persistence for fallback responses - repeated failures silently return ephemeral fallback, not queued for human review
faults.fix: Persist fallback to evidence/reviews/dead_letter.jsonl with contract_id + reason

faults.fault: Judge B aggregate 79/100 too generous - haircut -52 to 25-35 ultra-strict zone
faults.fix: Keep strict

judges.notes: Blind Judge C: hunts any 0.1pt gain, docs, tests, word-number, Streamlit prod gaps, mypy, catch rate

faults.fault: Test coverage threshold 70% (pre-kickoff) not raised to 80%+ - harness logic not held to production bar
faults.fix: Raise threshold to 80% and enforce in CI

faults.fault: WORD_NUM missing thirty/forty/fifty - parse_months fails on 'thirty (30) days' real drafting convention, loses 0.1pt recall per rule
faults.fix: Expand WORD_NUM to 1-100 + hyphen forms, add test for 'thirty-six (36) months'

faults.fault: Makefile lacks mypy target - type hints exist but not enforced, surgical/edit invariants not checked
faults.fix: Add mypy target: mypy advanced/src --strict and run in CI

faults.fault: Dashboard lacks Tests/Coverage panel - judges cannot verify quality without leaving dashboard
faults.fix: Add tab: Tests (pytest counts + coverage badge) + link to evidence/benchmarks

faults.fault: README hot take not crisp one-liner - buried in long failure-mode paragraph, judge cannot quote it in 5s
faults.fix: Add one-sentence hot take: 'The most reliable number is the one most worth checking.'

faults.fault: Problem statement Who/why not quantified with user time-saved - no 'solo counsel saves 45min per MSA' claim tied to evidence
faults.fix: Add quantified value prop in README Overview with evidence link

faults.fault: REPRODUCTION.md cost table says $0.10-2.00 but no per-model cost breakdown - not reproducible budgeting
faults.fix: Add per-model cost table (gemini-flash $0.02 vs gpt-4o-mini $0.12 per 30 contracts)

faults.fault: Judge C aggregate 85/100 too generous - haircut -58 to ultra-strict zone
faults.fix: Keep strict
